plain: I'll design your website and deliver it by May 20.
legal: The Designer shall design the Client's website and deliver it on or before May 20.

plain: The project includes up to 3 rounds of changes.
legal: The Project fee shall include up to three (3) rounds of revisions.

plain: Extra changes will cost $75 per hour.
legal: Any revisions beyond those included shall be charged at $75 per hour.

plain: You need to send me all the text and images before I can start.
legal: The Client shall provide all text and images required for the Project prior to commencement of the work.

plain: If you're late sending materials, the deadline moves back by the same amount of time.
legal: Any delay by the Client in providing materials shall extend the delivery deadline by an equivalent period.

plain: I'm an independent contractor, not your employee.
legal: The Contractor is an independent contractor and not an employee of the Client.

plain: I'll handle my own taxes.
legal: The Contractor shall be solely responsible for the payment of the Contractor's own taxes.

plain: I can choose how and when I do the work, as long as I meet the deadlines.
legal: The Contractor may determine the manner and timing of the performance of the Services, provided that all deadlines are met.

plain: I may hire helpers, but I'm responsible for their work.
legal: The Contractor may engage assistants, but shall remain responsible for their work.

plain: You have 5 business days to review each delivery and tell me if something is wrong.
legal: The Client shall review each deliverable within five (5) business days and notify the Contractor of any deficiency.

plain: If I don't hear from you within 5 business days, the delivery is considered approved.
legal: If the Client fails to respond within five (5) business days, the deliverable shall be deemed accepted.

plain: I'll fix any mistakes I made at no extra cost.
legal: The Contractor shall correct any errors attributable to the Contractor at no additional cost.

plain: Hosting and domain fees are not included.
legal: Hosting and domain registration fees are not included in the fees.

plain: The cleaning service comes every Tuesday at 10 am.
legal: The cleaning service shall be provided every Tuesday at 10 am.

plain: If you need to cancel a cleaning, let us know 24 hours in advance or you'll be charged.
legal: Cancellation of a scheduled cleaning shall require not less than twenty-four (24) hours' notice, failing which the full fee shall be charged.

plain: Our cleaners won't move heavy furniture.
legal: The cleaning personnel shall not be required to move heavy furniture.

plain: You need to provide access to the property on cleaning days.
legal: The Client shall provide access to the Property on each scheduled cleaning day.

plain: The consultant will provide a written report within 6 weeks.
legal: The Consultant shall deliver a written report within six (6) weeks.

plain: The consultant's advice is not legal or financial advice.
legal: The advice provided by the Consultant shall not constitute legal or financial advice.

plain: We'll respond to support tickets within 4 hours during business hours.
legal: The Provider shall respond to support requests within four (4) hours during business hours.

plain: Critical issues get a response within 1 hour, any time of day.
legal: Critical incidents shall receive a response within one (1) hour, at any time of day.

plain: The service will be available 99.9% of the time each month.
legal: The Service shall be available for not less than 99.9% of each calendar month.

plain: If we miss the uptime target, you get a 10% credit on that month's bill.
legal: In the event that the availability commitment is not met, the Customer shall receive a credit equal to 10% of the fees for the affected month.

plain: Planned maintenance doesn't count as downtime.
legal: Scheduled maintenance shall not be regarded as downtime.

plain: We'll tell you about planned maintenance at least 48 hours ahead.
legal: The Provider shall give not less than forty-eight (48) hours' notice of any scheduled maintenance.

plain: The tutor will teach 2 one-hour lessons per week.
legal: The Tutor shall provide two (2) one-hour lessons per week.

plain: Missed lessons can be rescheduled once if you tell us a day before.
legal: A missed lesson may be rescheduled once, provided that notice is given one (1) day in advance.

plain: The caterer will provide food and drinks for 120 guests.
legal: The Caterer shall supply food and beverages for one hundred and twenty (120) guests.

plain: The final guest count must be confirmed 10 days before the event.
legal: The final number of guests shall be confirmed not less than ten (10) days before the Event.

plain: The caterer isn't responsible for food allergies that weren't disclosed.
legal: The Caterer shall not be liable for any allergic reaction arising from an allergy not disclosed in advance.

plain: The DJ will play from 8 pm to midnight.
legal: The DJ shall perform from 8 pm until midnight.

plain: Each extra hour of music costs $150.
legal: Each additional hour of performance shall be charged at $150.

plain: The plumber guarantees the work for 6 months.
legal: The Plumber warrants the workmanship for a period of six (6) months.

plain: Parts are charged separately at cost plus 10%.
legal: Parts shall be charged separately at cost plus 10%.

plain: We'll give you a written quote before doing any work.
legal: The Contractor shall provide a written quotation prior to commencing any work.

plain: If the job will cost more than the quote, we'll ask you before going ahead.
legal: The Contractor shall obtain the Client's approval before incurring any cost in excess of the quotation.

plain: The translator will deliver the translated documents by email.
legal: The Translator shall deliver the translated documents by email.

plain: The translation fee is $0.12 per word.
legal: The translation fee shall be $0.12 per word.

plain: Rush jobs delivered within 24 hours cost 50% more.
legal: A surcharge of 50% shall apply to urgent assignments delivered within twenty-four (24) hours.

plain: The agency will post on your social media accounts 3 times a week.
legal: The Agency shall publish content on the Client's social media accounts three (3) times per week.

plain: You must approve each post before it goes live.
legal: Each post shall be subject to the Client's approval prior to publication.

plain: The agency won't buy fake followers or likes.
legal: The Agency shall not purchase artificial followers or engagement.

plain: Monthly reports will be sent by the 5th of the next month.
legal: Monthly reports shall be delivered by the fifth (5th) day of the following month.

plain: The gardener will cut the grass and trim the hedges every two weeks.
legal: The Gardener shall mow the lawn and trim the hedges every two (2) weeks.

plain: Garden waste will be taken away for an extra $20 per visit.
legal: Garden waste shall be removed for an additional charge of $20 per visit.

plain: The accountant needs all your receipts by February 28.
legal: The Client shall provide all receipts to the Accountant no later than February 28.

plain: The accountant isn't responsible for errors in information you provided.
legal: The Accountant shall not be liable for any error arising from inaccurate information supplied by the Client.

plain: The trainer will create a 12-week workout plan.
legal: The Trainer shall prepare a twelve (12) week exercise program.

plain: Talk to your doctor before starting the program.
legal: The Client shall consult a medical practitioner before commencing the program.

plain: The photographer will deliver at least 300 edited photos within 4 weeks.
legal: The Photographer shall deliver not less than three hundred (300) edited photographs within four (4) weeks.

plain: Raw files aren't included.
legal: Unedited raw files shall not be included in the deliverables.

plain: The moving company will pack, move and unpack everything on June 3.
legal: The Removal Company shall pack, transport and unpack all items on June 3.

plain: Fragile items must be marked by the customer.
legal: The Customer shall clearly mark all fragile items.

plain: Our IT team will patch your servers once a month.
legal: The Provider shall apply security patches to the Customer's servers once per month.

plain: We'll keep a log of all changes made to your systems.
legal: The Provider shall maintain a record of all changes made to the Customer's systems.

plain: The developer will provide 30 days of free support after launch.
legal: The Developer shall provide free support for a period of thirty (30) days following launch.

plain: After that, support is $500 a month.
legal: Thereafter, support services shall be charged at $500 per month.

plain: The coach will be available for calls on weekdays between 9 am and 5 pm.
legal: The Coach shall be available for telephone consultations on weekdays between 9 am and 5 pm.

plain: Sessions cancelled with less than 12 hours' notice are still charged.
legal: Any session cancelled with less than twelve (12) hours' notice shall be charged in full.

plain: The architect will submit the plans for planning approval.
legal: The Architect shall submit the plans to the relevant authority for approval.
